# go.dev/issue/65612
# go vet should set the GoVersion for command line files.

# The local version is above every go and go.work line here, so nothing
# needs a newer toolchain and each assertion reads its own source.
env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.22.5

go vet -n -json example.com/m
stderr '"GoVersion": "go1.22.0"'

# A command line file should use the local go version.
go vet -n -json main.go
stderr '"GoVersion": "go1.22.5"'

# In workspace mode a package still reads its own go.mod. A command line
# file has no module, so it reads the local go version here too: the go.work
# line reaches vet only through a package's module.
cp go.work.orig go.work
go vet -n -json example.com/m
stderr '"GoVersion": "go1.22.0'

go vet -n -json main.go
stderr '"GoVersion": "go1.22.5'

# Without go.mod or go.work, the command line file version should use local go version .
env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.22.3
rm go.mod
rm go.work

! go vet -n -json example.com/m

go vet -n -json main.go
stderr '"GoVersion": "go1.22.3"'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22.0

-- go.work.orig --
go 1.22.2

use .

-- main.go --
package main
